Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Edward de Vere's paternal grandfather as John de Vere, 14th Earl of Oxford, instead of John de Vere, 15th Earl of Oxford. This error occurred due to a flawed assumption that the paternal grandfather would be two generations up from Edward (the 14th Earl), rather than one generation up (the 15th Earl). This misunderstanding persisted despite the WebSurfer providing accurate information that the father of John de Vere, 16th Earl of Oxford, is John de Vere, 15th Earl of Oxford. The Planner failed to integrate this correct information into its reasoning, leading to the propagation of the wrong solution.
